content: [ version 0.1 ] Site has officially been launched! Currently super super under construction, gna be working on things over the next few months
Temporary music page set up at /music.html, more music to come
Been a while!! Set up a new docs page at /docs/docs_main.html. Here you can find documents of all sorts, usually pertaining to videos
Small quality of life thingy, citations on document pages can now be toggled on and off
[ version 0.2 ] We have a toolbar! Toolbar will be availible on pretty much every page except index for the forseeable future and is managed by a script and json file for easy updates

[ version 1.0 ] The site is no longer under construction!!! Well, it technically is, but for the time being we have a proper index page, some about pages, a working toolbar and much more. More work to come!
